verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are driven headlessly through first-party SDKs (Python, JS, Go) and an official CLI. These let scripts and agents create sandboxes and exec commands without any UI, so the core of headless automation is clearly delivered. The evidence does not document CI-specific usage, such as non-interactive auth or tokens for CI runners, or a documented CI integration or recipe. The community GitHub Actions item describes hosting CI runners on Modal rather than invoking Modal from CI. missing for 10: documented CI pipeline usage (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab recipe), non-interactive credential/token setup for CI, independent hands-on corroboration of running Modal from a CI job.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Spin up fresh, isolated sandboxes programmatically.
